checks: Oversized/zero reads preserve buffered data and perform no transfer.
flush is a no-op for RX and TX; repeated begin calls preserve active state.

An application mutex protects full Wire exchanges; unsynchronized tasks share TX/RX state.
Pin setters accept the current live route and fail explicitly for invalid changes.
Address-only probes return ACK/NACK without payload and always finish with STOP.
All 22 rewritten roo_io review commits contain no discardReceived workaround; unrelated changes/messages are preserved.
